title: Instructor / Assistant / Associate / Professor of Economics
description:
Description

Flagler College is seeking an Instructor/ Assistant / Associate /
Professor of Economics to begin August 2027. The desired candidate
will have strong teaching as well as a record of student
mentorship, scholarship, and service. This is a full-time position
with an annual teaching load of 4/4. Salary and benefits
competitive and commensurate with rank and experience. Future
promotion in rank is based upon review and evaluation of the
successful candidate’s teaching, professional development, and
service in accordance with Flagler College’s guidelines. We seek a
colleague who demonstrates an enthusiasm for teaching in an
undergraduate liberal arts environment. Teaching responsibilities
include introductory and upper-level Economics courses in support
of the Economics major and other Business program areas. In
addition to these core teaching and scholarly duties, the Professor
coordinates the School’s partnership with the Mercatus Center at
George Mason University, manages the Endowed Fund for Excellence in
Applied Politics and Civic Literacy, and helps develop an
integrated academic program in Philosophy, Political Science, and
Economics (PPE) in partnership with colleagues across the
Humanities and Social Sciences.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: A Master’s Degree in a business related
field with a minimum of 18 student credit hours in Economics.

Preferred Qualifications: A PhD in Economics or ABD with expected
completion before August 2027. Demonstrated teaching excellence in
several of the following undergraduate areas preferred: Principles
of Micro and Macro, Money and Banking, Law and Economics, other
specialization areas, and/or industry experience. A demonstrated
commitment to student mentorship. Presentation of an active
professional development / scholarly activity agenda.

Application Instructions

A complete application will include a letter of application (cover
letter), curriculum vita, a brief statement of teaching philosophy,
unofficial transcripts, examples of syllabi and teaching
evaluations, and contact information for three references (include
full name, email address, and telephone number). References will
only be contacted for those that are advanced to Finalist status.
Applications received by January 30th will receive full
consideration.

All application materials should be submitted through Interfolio at
https://apply.interfolio.com/197815


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Flagler College provides equal employment opportunities to all
employees and applicants for employment without regard to race,
color, gender, religion, national origin, age, disability, marital
status, familial status, sexual orientation, gender identity or
expression, or any other protected characteristic. In addition to

state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in
every location in which the College has facilities. This policy
applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including

Inquiries regarding discrimination on the basis of sex and gender
